suggestions: Non-blocking accessibility improvement — site/index.html has two visible main elements. Prefer one main landmark (or make the hero wrapper a section/div) and add a skip-to-content link. Existing native controls, labels, aria-pressed state, live regions, image alternatives and visible focus styling are present; this was static inspection, not assistive-technology testing.

Non-blocking test coverage improvement — tests/model.test.cjs exercises the estimator but not app.js DOM interactions. Add tests for changing all four modes, tile-button state/panel updates, clearing numeric inputs, and recovery after invalid input; explicitly test dimension endpoints 1, 4096 and rejection of 4097. Extend static link tests to script/image/style src/href targets. These additional local asset checks passed during this review.

Non-blocking numerical clarity improvement — next to the minimal BF16 C++ microkernel in site/index.html, explicitly state that the non-BFP explanation assumes AIE_API_EMULATE_BFLOAT16_MMUL_WITH_BFP16 is undefined. If enabled, refer readers to the audit's rounding-mode save/set/restore example and changed precision semantics. The displayed 4x8x8 specialization and public load_v/mul/to_vector/store_v signatures are valid at source level; no confirmed compilation blocker was found.

Non-blocking evidence visibility improvement — surface the audit's unverified signed-i16 direct AIEVec lowering concern near the type table, carefully distinguishing it from the IRON C++ int16 kernel. The current site does not claim that all signed-i16 frontend paths have been validated, so this is not a contradiction or blocker.

Non-blocking presentation improvement — the Step 2 kernels.mm excerpt uses np.float32 without repeating import numpy as np and shares a code block with a shell-option fragment. It is explicitly contextual rather than standalone, and NumPy was imported in Step 1, but separate language-labelled blocks and a repeated import would make copying safer.
summary: PASS for the bounded static research/educational-site review; no publication-blocking security, logic or factual defect identified. Read all seven requested site files and all three test source files. Required commands succeeded: node --test tests/model.test.cjs (8/8) and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests (3/3). Both JavaScript files passed node --check. Cross-checked IRON Program, Runtime, Worker, ObjectFifo fill/drain, NPU2 export, In/Out imports and Tensor.__array__ against local implementations; the add_one excerpt also passes Python syntax parsing. Verified whole_array CLI names and the displayed shape constraints, kernels.mm keyword arguments/mac_dims/zero, the Triton example path, tl.dot excerpt, AIE2P packing and transform environment-variable lookup against local sources. Checked the C++ mmul template, vector sizes, multiplication and result-conversion contracts plus load/store signatures. The corrected INT4 unpack, native INT32xINT16 exception, unsupported/unconfirmed BFP8 and arch21-versus-22 wording agree with the supplied audit; no unsupported blanket native-support or locally-executed-benchmark claim found. Local paper/README evidence supports the quoted benchmark numbers and stated limitations. All 17 manifest document byte counts/SHA-256 hashes and all six repository HEADs match; local HTML assets/downloads, internal anchors and immutable GitHub source-link paths resolve locally. External URL availability, rendered browser behavior, full accessibility conformance, compiler compatibility and hardware correctness were not tested. No web research, installation, toolchain build, NPU/benchmark execution, service change, site modification or publication was performed. Only this requested review report was intentionally written.
